items.description: Forced distribution updates can remove project-authored steering Markdown files.
items.analysis: The new obsolete-steering discovery treats every Markdown file absent from the package as distributable content, while `.agents/steering/` may contain project-owned overrides.
items.recommendation: Limit removal to steering files known to have been installed by Specle.
items.dispatch_result: Replace managed steering removal with a managed policies directory; leave steering user-owned and migrate only this repository.

items.description: Status-record and selector symlinks could make local validation hang or exhaust memory.
items.analysis: The finding assumes malicious local repository files such as symlinks to special devices.
items.recommendation: Reject symlinks, non-regular files, and unbounded reads.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: hostile-local-input hardening is disproportionate for the user-selected checkout model.

items.description: Lifecycle validation accepts statuses that are impossible for a record's kind.
items.analysis: Validation checks against the union of lifecycle statuses rather than the statuses permitted for a record's kind.
items.recommendation: Validate status compatibility with kind from lifecycle declarations.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision for kind-specific lifecycle validation.

items.description: Direct-delivery specs can become complete without archive finalisation.
items.analysis: Local-only and direct-upstream delivery can set complete, but the present complete workflow only handles committed branch-and-PR delivery.
items.recommendation: Make archive finalisation available to every effective completion path.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision for archive finalisation across delivery models.

items.description: Spike completion does not update durable status or use a stable outcome-spec reference.
items.analysis: The new spike creation record is durable, but completion guidance still needs to update it and preserve outcome links through archival.
items.recommendation: Set completed spikes to `complete` and store the outcome spec's stable name.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision for durable spike completion.

items.description: Interrupted archive finalisation can leave a selector pointing to an archived or non-complete record.
items.analysis: The proposed sequence moved the directory before delivery authorisation and local selector clearing.
items.recommendation: Authorise first, then perform archive move, durable status update, and selector clearing as one recoverable finalisation operation.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision for recoverable authorised archive finalisation.

items.description: Activation of an already prepared spec invokes build while status remains defined.
items.analysis: Unselected planning artifacts do not advance durable status, but build correctly refuses a defined target.
items.recommendation: Reconcile preparation artifacts to planned before activation invokes build.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision for prepared-spec activation.

items.description: Concurrent activation in one worktree could overwrite the local selector.
items.analysis: The scenario requires concurrent agents mutating one checkout; separate worktrees are the intended concurrency boundary.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: same-worktree concurrency is outside the workflow model.

items.description: Summary generation can recreate an active directory for an archived target.
items.analysis: Target selection supports archived work but the documented output path is still fixed under active specs.
items.recommendation: Write summary.md within the target's resolved active or archived directory.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision for archive-aware summary output.

items.description: External projects with legacy context-only specs would be inaccessible after upgrade.
items.analysis: The report assumes released installations that must be migrated in place.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: Specle is unreleased and this change migrates its only known repository.

items.description: Lifecycle steering still directs abbreviated workflows to retired queue records.
items.analysis: Some transition descriptions were not fully updated from the shared-context model.
items.recommendation: Rewrite them to use per-spec status and local selection.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision to remove retired queue terminology.

items.description: A progressed normal spec cannot be reselected when a checkout has no local selector.
items.analysis: Activation accepts only defined work even though fresh checkouts can contain planned or later resumable normal specs.
items.recommendation: Allow activation of appropriate non-terminal normal states and dispatch their derived next step.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision for resumable normal-spec activation.

items.description: A merged delivery awaiting archival can block selection of unrelated work.
items.analysis: The unfinished-selection guard does not yet recognise the decided effective-completion rule.
items.recommendation: Treat confirmed final delivery evidence as effectively complete for selector replacement.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision for effective-completion selection handling.

items.description: A duplicate stable name can still resolve to the active copy.
items.analysis: Duplicate diagnostics must block normal target resolution. Full investigation and recovery need a separate, deliberately scoped workflow.
items.recommendation: Reject duplicate identities now; add explicit reconciliation separately.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision to block ordinary ambiguous resolution; the independent add-specle-reconcile change records later read-only analysis and confirmed recovery.

items.description: A validator can transiently see duplicate locations while finalisation moves a spec.
items.analysis: The scenario needs concurrent mutation and validation in one checkout.
items.recommendation: Add scan retry or move/read coordination.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: same-worktree concurrent read/write coordination is outside the workflow model.

items.description: Review-finding follow-up references use mutable spec paths.
items.analysis: A dispatched independent follow-up needs a durable link, but paths are not durable across archive moves.
items.recommendation: Use `resulting_spec_name` for new workflow records and migrate historical archived paths.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision: new workflow records use `resulting_spec_name` only; historical archived `resulting_spec_path` fields are not migrated.

items.description: Status can list a complete active-location spec as pending.
items.analysis: Direct-delivery completion can temporarily retain the directory under active specs before finalisation archives it.
items.recommendation: Exclude complete records from pending output except as explicit dependency context.
items.dispatch_result: Routed to active revision to exclude active complete records from pending status output.

items.description: A newly initialised project can later create a trackable local selector.
items.analysis: Initialisation predates local selector state and currently creates only .agents, but `.specle/.gitignore` is a once-created project bootstrap file.
items.recommendation: Have `specle init` safely create the target's `.specle/.gitignore` with anchored local-state rules.
items.dispatch_result: Create `.specle/.gitignore` at init time only; do not create a selector or spec runtime state.

items.description: A commenced spike can replace or omit the local selection.
items.analysis: A spike is work requiring the same single-worktree selection guard as a normal change. Selection mutation must have exactly one owner.
items.recommendation: Have spike write current-spec when execution begins.
items.dispatch_result: Spike creation remains unselected; `activate` is the sole writer of `.specle/current-spec` and invokes a valid spike.
